overview: This table pairs a keyboard key with the icon shown in control hints, with different artwork for French and German keyboards.
description: One row associates a currently bound keyboard FKey with the three-size inline guide brush set used by the keyboard input-guide decorator; French and German layouts can override each size.

InputKey.simple: The key players press for the action shown in this control hint. Change it when that action's assigned key changes.
InputKey.technical: FKey, initialized to EKeys::Invalid by the row constructor. The decorator first requires TagOrId to parse as an EGameInputKey enumerator name; it then asks the input manager for that game key's bound keys for player 0 and, only if no row matched, player 1. Only Keys[0] is compared with this field, and the first matching RowMap entry wins. The row name and any additional bound keys are ignored. The scan casts row bytes directly without a row-struct check. Default binds built in the input manager's BeginPlay are remapped for French and German layouts (W/Z, A/Q, Y/Z), so the post-remap FKey is what must be stored here.

Brush.simple: The normal-sized icon players see for this key in control hints. French and German keyboards use their own icon when one is provided.
Brush.technical: FSlateBrush returned for EGameWidgetInputGuideSizeType::Normal (1). After a row matches, French or German selects Brush_French or Brush_German only when that localized brush passes HasUObject(); otherwise this brush is returned. Other languages use this brush for Normal. Any unrecognized size value returns nullptr without using a brush.

SmallBrush.simple: The small icon players see for this key when control hints use small symbols. French and German keyboards have their own when provided.
SmallBrush.technical: FSlateBrush returned for EGameWidgetInputGuideSizeType::Small (2). After a row matches, French or German selects SmallBrush_French or SmallBrush_German only when the localized brush passes HasUObject(); otherwise this brush is returned. Other languages use this brush for Small. Any unrecognized size value returns nullptr without using a brush.

TinyBrush.simple: The tiny icon players see when small control hints appear on Steam Deck. French and German keyboards can have their own.
TinyBrush.technical: FSlateBrush returned for EGameWidgetInputGuideSizeType::Tiny (3). After a row matches, French or German selects TinyBrush_French or TinyBrush_German only when the localized brush passes HasUObject(); otherwise this brush is returned. Other languages use this brush for Tiny. Any unrecognized size value returns nullptr without using a brush.

Brush_French.simple: The normal-sized icon used when the game treats the keyboard as French. If no picture is assigned, the usual normal icon appears.
Brush_French.technical: FSlateBrush selected for Normal when AInputManager::GetKeyboardLanguage() is French. SelectLocalized returns this brush only if HasUObject() is true; otherwise the decorator falls back to the same row's default Brush. It is not consulted for other languages, sizes, or rows.

SmallBrush_French.simple: The small icon used when the game treats the keyboard as French. If no picture is assigned, the usual small icon appears.
SmallBrush_French.technical: FSlateBrush selected for Small when AInputManager::GetKeyboardLanguage() is French. SelectLocalized returns this brush only if HasUObject() is true; otherwise the decorator falls back to the same row's default SmallBrush. It is not consulted for other languages, sizes, or rows.

TinyBrush_French.simple: The tiny icon used when the game treats the keyboard as French. If no picture is assigned, the usual tiny icon appears.
TinyBrush_French.technical: FSlateBrush selected for Tiny when AInputManager::GetKeyboardLanguage() is French. SelectLocalized returns this brush only if HasUObject() is true; otherwise the decorator falls back to the same row's default TinyBrush. It is not consulted for other languages, sizes, or rows.

Brush_German.technical: FSlateBrush selected for Normal when AInputManager::GetKeyboardLanguage() is German. SelectLocalized returns this brush only if HasUObject() is true; otherwise the decorator falls back to the same row's default Brush. It is not consulted for other languages, sizes, or rows.

SelectLocalized returns this brush only if HasUObject() is true; otherwise the decorator falls back to the same row's default SmallBrush. It is not consulted for other languages, sizes, or rows.

usages.detail: The keyboard decorator subclass owns the CustomImageSet UDataTable pointer (default null); GetCustomImageSet returns it to the shared FindImageBrush implementation.

FindImageBrush requires a non-null CustomImageSet, parses TagOrId as an EGameInputKey name, and routes game-key tags to the keyboard/controller bindings; non-game-key tags use the dynamic-icon fallback parameter instead of this row struct.
GetKeyboardKeys copies the bound FKey list for the requested game key and player; the decorator compares only its first element with row InputKey.

The manager loads BP_InputGuideTextDecorator_Keyboard from /Game/Widgets/StreamingAssets/InputGuide/Win64/ and caches the class for keyboard lookups; the BP's actual table assignment is not in the source snapshot.
Widget input images resolve the cached decorator class, call FindImageBrush on its class default object with an EGameInputKey name and Normal size, then apply the brush's resource object.
Rich-text runs use the active guide decorator's FindImageBrush; an input-guide text owner supplies Normal, Small, or Tiny from GetIconSizeType (Small when bUseSmallIcon, Tiny on Steam Deck).

notes: The keyboard path looks up by current binding, not by row name: TagOrId is an EGameInputKey enumerator name, and the matched row's InputKey must equal the first FKey bound to that game key for player 0 or 1. bWarnIfMissing is not read by FindImageBrush.

Localization uses AInputManager::GetKeyboardLanguage(), derived at BeginPlay from the Windows keyboard layout. French Canadian maps to English, French Swiss/Luxembourg and several Central European layouts map to German; only French and German consult the localized brushes. KeyAliases are used by watched-key checks, not by this direct FKey comparison.

A null CustomImageSet returns nullptr before tag parsing or fallback. A game-key tag with an empty binding list or no matching row also returns nullptr; it does not fall back to the dynamic-icon parameter. Non-game-key tags never consult this table's rows.

SelectLocalized tests HasUObject(), so a brush with no resource and no deprecated UObject flag is rejected in favor of the size-matched default; a set flag can still win even if the resource object is null.
Unknown EGameWidgetInputGuideSizeType values return nullptr. Inline guide text uses Normal by default and selects Small or Tiny as described above; UGameWidgetInputImage always requests Normal.

The keyboard scan reads RowMap entries by direct byte cast without validating RowStruct. Assign a table whose rows really are FGameWidgetInputGuideKeyboardImageRow; its row names have no role in this lookup.

No DataTable export shard contains this row struct or its fields, and the generated row-key index is empty. The retail Blueprint that sets CustomImageSet and the actual retail table rows are not part of the exports or source snapshot; runtime behavior here is from the reconstructed C++ consumer.
Retail layout evidence lists the ten properties in this order with InputKey at offset 8 and the nine FSlateBrush values at offsets 32, 240, 448, 656, 864, 1072, 1280, 1488 and 1696.
